Team + Claire/Samir —

High level: BrightFin is bringing two executive VIPs to the June 10 virtual panel. We need to confirm arrival/arrival prep, vet bios for onscreen slides, and lock a greenroom window for a 10–15m mic/latency check the morning of the event. Quick asks below so we can hand this off to Production by EOD: 

- Marissa: can you confirm travel/arrival times for the VIPs and whether they need an earlier briefing slot? If so, capture calendar availability and any dietary or accessibility notes.
- Lauren: please draft a short 6-minute intro script and a 1-slide title slate per VIP. I attached a starter VIP_Slate_0530.csv — populate slide text and one-sentence placeholder bios.
- Laura: please loop in StudioOps (Samir) for AV checks and confirm the greenroom ops PDF (I asked Samir to review).
- Claire: could you send final headshots and any preferred pronunciations/phonetic names? If either VIP has a PR handler we should add them to the backchannel.

Samir — can StudioOps commit to a greenroom test window on the morning of June 10 between 09:30–10:30 PT, and confirm whether we can reserve a dedicated backup link? Also, we need a short latency test (share sample tokenized prompt) so the team can calculate expected median token latency for the live demo.

Attachments: VIP_Slate_0530.csv (starter)

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
